name: The Gathering Storm
description: January 1936: Germany rearms, Italy fights in Ethiopia, Japan rules Manchuria, and the Soviet Union industrialises at breakneck speed. The peace of Versailles is fraying.
approximations: Borders follow modern admin-1 provinces, so each province goes to whoever held most of it on 1 January 1936 (e.g. Polish eastern lands as L'viv, Ivano-Frankivs'k, Rivne, Brest, Grodno and Vilnius; Istria and Inner Carniola to Italy; Italian-occupied Tigray to Italy; Jehol and western Manchuria to Manchukuo; south Sakhalin, Danzig, Tangier and Hatay not represented separately). Mandates are owned by the mandatory power. Population (millions) and GDP (billions of 1990 international dollars) are rounded Maddison-style estimates including colonies; army sizes are rounded peacetime strengths (Italy and Ethiopia already mobilised).
